ModSporeling.name: Sporeling
ModSporeling.attack: Puff a short cloud of poison spores
ModSporeling.special: Scatter: shake two seeds out of your cap
passive: Seeds next to you ripen much faster
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModThornbiter.name: Thornbiter
ModThornbiter.attack: Long vine whip that may bleed
ModThornbiter.special: Root Run: roots race at the hero and root him
passive: Your roots plant a seed where they stop
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModRotfly.name: Rotfly
ModRotfly.attack: Spit a poison glob, mid range
ModRotfly.special: Buzz Bomb: dive, burst a poison puff, climb back
passive: Spit that misses lands as a seed
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModSylSporeHusk.name: Spore Husk
ModSylSporeHusk.attack: Club smash that bursts a poison cloud
ModSylSporeHusk.special: Spore Belch: a wide cone of poison spores
passive: Your smash bursts every ripe pod nearby
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModBloomWitch.name: Bloom Witch
ModBloomWitch.attack: Pollen lance: pierces, long range, may poison
ModBloomWitch.special: Graft a ripe pod onto your kin and yourself
passive: Graft ripe pods onto your kin's heads
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModBrambleKnight.name: Bramble Knight
ModBrambleKnight.special: Overgrow: four thorn patches burst up round you
passive: Your sweep's tip plants a thorn patch
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModSylStrangler.name: Strangler Vine
ModSylStrangler.special: Lasso a pod or seed near you and sling it at him

Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod
ModSylStrangler.vault: A braided vine serpent. It lassoes ripe pods and slings them at its prey

ModSylGallWasp.name: Gall Wasp
ModSylGallWasp.attack: Needle that plants a seed where it lands
ModSylGallWasp.special: Dart through the hero, dropping two seeds

Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModSylBloatfly.name: Bloatfly
ModSylBloatfly.attack: Retch a cone of poison bile

Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod
ModSylBloatfly.vault: Retches bile from on high. Poison lingers on whoever stands in it

ModSylBriarBehemoth.name: Briar Behemoth
ModSylBriarBehemoth.special: Charge; your bush swings in as you stop

Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModSylBriarChampion.name: Briar Champion

Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModSylPuffball.name: Puffball Brute

Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModSylCordyceps.name: Cordyceps Saint

Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModRotMother.name: The Rot Mother

Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModSylNightshade.name: Nightshade

Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModSylPollenMonarch.name: Pollen Monarch

Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModSylSower.name: The Sower

Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModSylCarrionLily.name: Carrion Lily
ModSylCarrionLily.special: Corpse Bloom: a wide cone of rot
passive: Planted, you heal and reach far. Uproot to move
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod

ModSylBriarWyrm.name: Briar Wyrm

ModSylBlightBellows.name: Blight Bellows

ModSylCarrionQueen.name: Carrion Queen

passive: Your drone keeps dazing him: stay close
Death drops a seed that ripens into a poison pod
ModSylCarrionQueen.vault: A fly queen whose droning wings daze anyone caught in the ring

ModSprout.name: Sprout
ModSprout.attack: Puff a tiny poison spore cloud
ModSprout.passive: Burst up through the floor round the hero

ModSylShambler.name: Shambler
passive: You stagger on a moment, then burst into seeds
ModSylShambler.vault: A corpse the cordyceps would not let die. It staggers on, then bursts into seeds
